verdict.rationale: Treg is a tool gateway and catalog. Aggregating third-party MCP servers is a plausible capability for this kind of product (a commenter names mcp-jungle as an alternative for the same purpose), so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Treg acting as an MCP server (`https://treg.to/mcp`, the Claude connector) and turning local CLIs or HTTP provider endpoints into team tools. Nothing shows users plugging their own MCP servers into Treg so it can use their tools.
